# Known documentation violations.
#
# One violation per line, as `<rule>:<path>:<detail>` — exactly what
# `python3 .github/scripts/check_docs.py --no-baseline` prints.
#
# This file exists so the docs gate could land while the repository already had
# outstanding problems, without going red on day one and blocking every pull
# request. It is a ratchet, not an exemption list:
#
#   - A violation not listed here fails the build.
#   - A line here that no longer matches a real violation ALSO fails the build,
#     because an exemption that outlives its problem is itself a stale document.
#
# Every entry below is one gap, tracked by a ticket. When the gap is closed the
# line must be deleted in the same commit that closes it; the gate will tell you
# if you forget. When the last entry is deleted, delete this file.
